game_concept: A programming puzzle set in The Kingdom – Village Green, the green outside the walls: the squire must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while rogue knights close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Village Green: the green outside the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Village Green, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while rogue knights close in. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the throne using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the throne is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Village Green'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Village Green.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The throne reached with actions_used <= 21.
